Platform Architecture

One Schema. One Event Bus. One Transaction Boundary.

Infrakinetic isn't a suite of integrated apps. It's a single database, a single event bus, and a single transaction boundary — with 11+ engines that literally cannot drift apart.

Core Architecture

Three Pillars That Make Everything Else Possible

Every differentiator — lifecycle spine, calibrated ML, atomic packs, free platform infra — derives from these three architectural decisions.

One Schema

Single PostgreSQL database. All engines — Commercial, Finance, HR, Payroll, Documents, Workflow — share tables. No ETL, no sync, no eventual consistency.

One Event Bus

Every write goes through logBusinessEvent + dispatchWorkAutomation. One append-only business_events table. Cross-engine automation is a query, not a project.

One Transaction Boundary

State changes, events, and automation dispatch happen in the same DB transaction. No dual-write problems. No outbox pattern needed.

Lifecycle Spine

10-state machine (prospect → churned → won_back) spanning Commercial → Sales → CX360. Renewal auto-creates opportunity. Expansion detected via opportunity_type.

Signal Framework

entity_scores table — insert-only, versioned formulas (heuristic_v1, heuristic_v2), ML rows alongside. Lead quality, opportunity priority, customer health, churn risk, relationship engagement.

Tenant Isolation

Isolation is enforced by the database on every table, not just by application code — so a missed filter in one screen can never leak another tenant's data. Standing test: output for tenant A is identical whether tenant B's rows exist or not.

Why This Matters

Versioned Formulas

heuristic_v1, heuristic_v2, ml_v1 coexist. Rebalancing weights never invalidates history.

History for Everything

Lead quality and opportunity priority become trend lines, not ephemeral browser values.

One Join to Outcomes

Correlate any score with any outcome — the precondition for all ML.

Tenant Isolation

DPDP 2023 Compliant by Architecture, Not Policy

Cross-tenant ML pooling is structurally impossible, not just against policy. Every query is scoped to its tenant at the database layer, and a standing test enforces it on every deploy.

Enforced at the database, not just in code

Every tenant's data is walled off at the database layer. Even if there were a bug in application code, the database itself would still block cross-tenant access — isolation doesn't depend on every screen getting the filter right.

No privileged bypass for ML

The scoring service connects with the same restricted, tenant-scoped access as everything else — never through an elevated path that could see across tenants. A missing tenant filter returns zero rows, not everyone's.

Per-tenant model artifacts

Trained models are stored and looked up per tenant, always. One tenant's model is never merged into or used to initialize another's.

Job-level scope

Every inference job is bound to exactly one tenant by construction — there's no shared batch that touches multiple tenants at once.

Standing Test

Automated test: model for tenant A produces identical output whether tenant B rows exist or not. Runs on every deploy.

Data Residency

Single-region RDS (ap-south-1). No cross-region replication. Encryption at rest + transit. Key management via AWS KMS.

Deployment & Operations

EC2 + RDS. PM2. EventBridge. S3 Artifacts.

Proven pattern from polynovea-payroll-compute. No Lambda for daily jobs. EventBridge triggers internal routes. Detached Python processes for ML.

API Server

Node.js on EC2 (t3.small), PM2 cluster mode. Health checks, graceful reloads, zero-downtime deploys.

PostgreSQL RDS

Flexible Server (B1ms). RLS, audit triggers, hash chains, automated backups, point-in-time recovery.

EventBridge Scheduler

Cron-expression rules → internal routes (/internal/*/run). No in-process cron. requirePlatformKey on every route.

S3 Artifacts

ML models in s3://polynovea-ml-artifacts/. Base model + per-tenant blended + tenant-only audit. Versioned by formula_version.
